summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Triveni Business Manager. Backend: 43/43 pytest cases passed (auth, customers, employees, tasks, accounts, HR attendance/leaves, tenders with file upload+download, dashboard, RBAC across admin/manager/employee). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): login screen renders with tabs, demo credentials block visible, login redirects to Dashboard tab. All 6 KPI cards render, quick actions visible, Business tab segmented control (Customers/Accounts) works, add-btn navigates to /customers/new form, saving persists and reflects in list + updates dashboard KPI. Tasks tab shows filter chips (all/todo/doing/done) and add-task. More tab shows profile, 4 module rows and Logout — logout returns to login screen. End-to-end integration (create customer via UI -> visible in list -> KPI updates from 0 to 1) verified. No deprecated Expo packages, no red-screen errors.

issues: Tab bar labels (Dashboard/Business/Tasks/More) render as anchor elements without aria-label or testID. This is minor for humans but makes automated tab clicks via role/testID unreliable (must use text-content or navigate by URL). Consider adding tabBarButtonTestID/tabBarAccessibilityLabel in (tabs)/_layout.tsx.

After successful Save, the form stays on /customers/new URL (data is saved but router.back/navigation to list does not fire visibly on web). On the next visit to Business tab the record is present, so it's a minor UX polish — consider explicit router.back() or router.replace('/business') plus success toast.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Non-fatal but should migrate style objects that use shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow on web or use Platform.select.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — check components that pass pointerEvents as prop; move it into StyleSheet.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID / tabBarAccessibilityLabel to Tabs.Screen options in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx so bottom tabs are directly targetable by automation.
(Optional) After Save on /customers/new (and other create forms) call router.replace('/business') or router.back() so the user is returned to the list.
(Optional) Address deprecated 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' RN web warnings — cosmetic only.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projection everywhere — good.
server.py is ~750 lines with all models + routes; consider splitting into routers/models modules once app grows (>700 line guideline).
get_object retries once on 503 storage reinit — good resilience pattern.

/api/files/{full_path} allows any authenticated user to download any file path (no per-tender ownership check). Acceptable for MVP but note as future hardening (only allow users linked to the tender).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_UI_Cust customer created via UI to verify persistence + KPI refresh, then deleted via API. Backend tests create TEST_-prefixed customers/employees/accounts/tasks/tenders and clean them up within tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://hr-tender-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Seeded users in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py and can be re-run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Google OAuth (/api/auth/session) was NOT exercised per request — only email/password path.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found; all requested backend endpoints and frontend flows work as designed.
